decks.notes: The deck focuses on using powerful aggressive creatures and disruptive enchantments to quickly overwhelm the opponent. By utilizing mana accelerants and cards like Chalice of the Void and Blood Moon to disrupt the opponent's game plan, the deck can quickly deploy threats like Pyrogoyf and Magus of the Moon to apply pressure. With cards like Fury and Sundering Eruption to deal with opposing threats, the deck aims to close out games swiftly and decisively. The inclusion of cards like Chrome Mox and City of Traitors allows for explosive starts and ensures a proactive game plan.

This deck focuses on using fast mana acceleration from Cloudpost and Tron lands to ramp into powerful threats like Emrakul, Ulamog, and Karn, the Great Creator. It also utilizes disruptive elements like Karn's Sylex and Glimmerpost to control the game and disrupt the opponent's strategy. With access to powerful colorless spells like Crop Rotation and Once Upon a Time, this deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with big threats while controlling the game with disruptive elements and powerful land interactions.

This deck is focused on quickly milling through the entire deck, putting key combo pieces into the graveyard, and then winning the game with "Thassa's Oracle". It uses cards like "Balustrade Spy" and "Undercity Informer" to quickly fill the graveyard, while also utilizing "Narcomoeba" and "Bridge from Below" for additional value. The deck also includes disruption cards like "Thoughtseize" and "Pact of Negation" to protect the combo. The goal is to execute the combo as quickly and efficiently as possible to win the game in a single turn.

This Dimir Tempo deck focuses on disrupting the opponent's strategy with hand disruption and counter spells, while maintaining pressure on the board with efficient threats like Brazen Borrower and Murktide Regent. The deck uses cards like Thoughtseize and Daze to disrupt the opponent's plays and protect its own threats, allowing it to chip away at the opponent's life total while controlling the pace of the game. With a mix of control and aggressive elements, this deck aims to outmaneuver and overwhelm the opponent in the early to mid-game.

The main focus of this deck is to control the board through the use of lands and land-related cards. By utilizing cards like Thespian's Stage, Dark Depths, and Crop Rotation, the deck aims to create powerful land-based combos that can quickly overwhelm the opponent. Cards like Exploration and Sylvan Library help with card advantage and mana ramp, while Wasteland and Boseiju, Who Endures provide disruption and protection. Overall, the deck leverages the synergy between lands and spells to establish a strong, controlling presence on the battlefield.

The main concept of this deck is to utilize the Mystic Forge combo strategy to generate massive amounts of mana and manipulate the top of the library to consistently play powerful artifacts and disrupt the opponent's game plan. By using cards like Karn, the Great Creator and Tezzeret, Cruel Captain, alongside artifacts like Mox Opal and Grim Monolith, the deck aims to create explosive plays and overwhelming board presence. The inclusion of cards like Urza's Saga and Ancient Tomb further enhance the deck's ability to ramp up quickly and overpower the opponent with resource advantage.

The main focus of this deck is to quickly play mana acceleration cards like Ancient Tomb and Simian Spirit Guide to get out powerful threats like Broadside Bombardiers and dragons such as The One Ring. By disrupting opponents with Chalice of the Void and Blood Moon, while also dealing direct damage with cards like Sundering Eruption and Fury, this deck aims to overwhelm and restrict the opponent's options while putting pressure on their life total with aggressive creatures and burn spells.

The main concept of this deck is to control the game by using Lands and disruptive spells to slow down the opponent. By utilizing cards like Dark Depths and Thespian's Stage to create powerful token creatures, along with Life from the Loam to recycle lands, the deck aims to outvalue the opponent in the long run. Cards like Wasteland and Mox Diamond help disrupt the opponent's mana base while cards like Boseiju, Who Endures and Malevolent Rumble can provide protection and removal. The deck also includes tutoring effects like Expedition Map and Crop Rotation to find key lands when needed.

The deck focuses on utilizing cards like Entomb and Reanimate to quickly bring powerful creatures like Archon of Cruelty and Atraxa, Grand Unifier onto the battlefield from the graveyard. Thoughtseize and Tamiyo, Inquisitive Student help control the opponent's hand and card draw. Additional card draw and manipulation with Ponder, Brainstorm, and Daze keep the deck consistent. Force of Will provides protection while Wasteland disrupts the opponent's mana base. The deck aims to quickly assemble its combo pieces and overwhelm the opponent with threats that are difficult to deal with.

The main focus of this deck is to quickly access and utilize powerful creatures from the graveyard through the use of cards like Reanimate and Entomb. The strategy involves controlling the game with disruption spells like Thoughtseize and Force of Will while setting up the combo pieces necessary to bring back high-impact creatures such as Archon of Cruelty and Atraxa, Grand Unifier. The deck also includes card draw and manipulation spells like Brainstorm and Ponder to help find the necessary pieces for the combo. Ultimately, the goal is to overwhelm the opponent with powerful creatures and win the game quickly.

This combo-reanimator deck focuses on quickly filling the graveyard with powerful creatures like Archon of Cruelty and Atraxa, Grand Unifier, then bringing them back into play using cards like Reanimate and Animate Dead. Thoughtseize and Tamiyo, Inquisitive Student help control the opponent's hand, while cards like Force of Will and Daze provide protection for the combo pieces. The deck also includes disruptive cards like Brazen Borrower and Murktide Regent, along with utility lands like Wasteland and Undercity Sewers to further disrupt the opponent's game plan.

This deck revolves around assembling a powerful engine using Mystic Forge to cast cards from the top of the library for free or reduced cost. It combines artifact manipulation and combo pieces to generate massive advantages and control the board. The goal is to quickly assemble the key pieces of the combo while disrupting the opponent's game plan with cards like Pithing Needle and Portable Hole. The deck aims to outvalue and outspeed the opponent using fast mana and powerful artifact synergy.

The deck focuses on quickly filling the graveyard with powerful creatures using cards like Entomb and Thoughtseize, then bringing them back into play with Reanimate and Animate Dead. It also includes disruptive elements like Daze and Wasteland to control the opponent's resources. The deck is designed to efficiently reanimate threats and disrupt the opponent's game plan, allowing for explosive turns and overwhelming board presence. It aims to win the game by overwhelming the opponent with powerful creatures before they can establish their own game plan.

This deck focuses on using aggressive creatures and mana acceleration to quickly overwhelm the opponent. By utilizing cards like Green Sun's Zenith and Once Upon a Time to tutor for key creatures, along with disruptive elements like Thoughtseize and Endurance, the deck aims to establish a dominant board presence early on. Cards like Grist, the Hunger Tide and Keen-Eyed Curator provide additional value and flexible options for adapting to different situations. The inclusion of land destruction like Wasteland also helps disrupt the opponent's game plan, allowing for a more aggressive playstyle.

This deck revolves around using Show and Tell and Sneak Attack to cheat out powerful creatures like Emrakul, the Aeons Torn and Atraxa, Grand Unifier onto the battlefield quickly. The deck also utilizes cards like Brainstorm and Ponder to set up the combo pieces, while also running counterspells like Force of Will to protect the combo. The inclusion of Omniscience allows for even more powerful plays, making it a dangerous combo deck that can overwhelm opponents with big threats early in the game.

This deck focuses on quickly generating mana and casting a high number of spells in a single turn to create a storm count, ultimately leading to a lethal Tendrils of Agony. The deck includes cards like Dark Ritual, Lion's Eye Diamond, and Infernal Tutor to accelerate the storm count, as well as disruption pieces like Thoughtseize and Duress to protect the combo. Additionally, cards like Ad Nauseam and Burning Wish provide additional card advantage and versatility in finding the win condition. The deck aims to efficiently combo off and win the game before the opponent can react.
